verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's coding-agent docs describe tracking multiple concurrent agent sessions from one workspace and reviewing/merging changes (github-copilot-docs-8, github-copilot-docs-14, github-copilot-docs-3), which implies some parallel-task-and-review capability, but this describes managing multiple distinct assigned tasks rather than explicitly running several attempts at the *same* task and comparing outcomes before choosing one. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of spawning multiple parallel attempts on one task, a UI for side-by-side diff/result comparison of attempts, and any independent/hands-on evidence confirming this workflow actually works as described.
